title: Anyone else familiar with a "weird" desert?
content: This could be just me cuz i did grow up in the desert, however i now live in the forest and have for the past 8 years. My mallworld isnt highly saturated with desert, there is only one distinct desert and its connected to the city that is called "chicago" but its not really chicago. I've never been so idk why that is something my brain associated with this mallworld city. Anyway the desert is weird because it seems like it's got a lot of waterways but no plantlife beyond the typical acacia/scrub bush you usually see. But the waterways and canals are teeming with all sorts of different fish. Some of my mallworld dreams I've actually went fishing in here and found trout, carp, huge catfish, crayfish. It didnt make sense, and every time it feels super dangerous because these waterways are either on private land or highly prone to flash flooding. When i end up in the mallworld desert it is ALWAYS connected to the city named chicago.
